map.基于堰流公式计算溢洪道泄流量（实用堰/宽顶堰）: Compute spillway discharge Q by the weir-flow formula from weir type, head over crest, width and composite discharge coefficient, for quick flood-release checks.
map.溢洪道泄流量按堰流公式计算：流量系数 m 反映堰型（实用堰约 0.48、宽顶堰约: Spillway discharge uses the weir-flow formula: discharge coefficient m reflects weir type (ogee about 0.48, broad-crested about 0.385), side-contraction coefficient ε corrects the contraction from piers and abutments, submergence coefficient σ corrects downstream submergence, L is the crest overflow width, H is the head over crest. Discharge is proportional to H^(3/2); doubling H raises discharge about 2.83×.
map.L：堰顶净宽（m），H：堰上水头（m）: L: net crest width (m), H: head over crest (m)
map.ε：侧收缩系数（0.9~1.0），σ：淹没系数（自由出流=1）: ε: side-contraction coefficient (0.9~1.0), σ: submergence coefficient (free outflow = 1)
map.g = 9.81 m/s²，综合系数 C = σ·ε·m·√(2g): g = 9.81 m/s², combined coefficient C = σ·ε·m·√(2g)
map.💡 实用堰（WES/克奥格型）m≈0.49；宽顶堰 m≈0.36；自由出流时 σ: 💡 Ogee weir (WES/Creager type) m≈0.49; broad-crested weir m≈0.36; free outflow σ=1, when downstream level is above crest σ<1.
map.校核洪水位下溢洪道泄流是否达标。: Check whether spillway discharge meets the standard at flood level.
map.下游消能与安全下泄。: Downstream energy dissipation and safe release.
map.部分开启 H 降，Q 随 H^1.5 快速减，需控开度匹配来水。: Partly open lowers H; Q drops fast with H^1.5, so set opening to match incoming flow.
map.实用堰流量系数高、泄流大，宽顶堰用于低堰明渠，系数不同。: Ogee weir has higher coefficient and larger discharge; broad-crested weir is for low weirs in open channels, with a different coefficient.
map.大流量下泄动能强，需消力池/挑流防冲毁下游。: Large discharge carries strong kinetic energy; stilling basin/deflector jet is needed to prevent scour of the downstream.
map.溢洪道泄流能力计算器 - 实用堰与宽顶堰泄流量计算，基于堰流公式。。科学研究工具: Spillway discharge capacity calculator — ogee and broad-crested weir discharge by the weir-flow formula. A scientific tool using standard formulas for accurate results.
map.堰流泄量（本页代码口径）：综合系数 C=淹没系数 σ×侧收缩系数 ε×流量系数: Weir discharge (page code basis): combined coefficient C = submergence σ×side contraction ε×discharge coefficient m×√(2×9.81); discharge Q = C×weir width L×head over crest H^1.5 (m³/s); mean velocity over the crest = Q÷(L×H) (m/s). Validation: if any of the five is 0 or invalid, the calculation stops with no output. Verdict: no fixed grading; switching the weir type auto-fills the coefficient — ogee m=0.49, broad-crested m=0.36, free outflow σ=1, and σ<1 when the downstream level is above the crest.
